title: Cute Grinch Theme
text: Cute Grinch Theme. This is a cute Grinch themed set of decor for tiered trays. I plan to do 2 trays this holiday season. One will be Grinch themed and the other will be a more traditional Christmas theme. The variety of pieces are good. They do have a mass produced quality to them - they're just a little too perfect and flat. The Grinch gnome is my favorite! I only need to add a few more items for my tray!
